status: Frozen before the four-path outcomes; exploratory follow-up to previously inspected two-view results
scope: Numerical-channel ablation only; not a rerun or replacement of the earlier mixed-field study
datasets: All 10 hazardous-waste and 10 water-treatment pairs generated by the existing frozen generator protocol, and all 5 previously used UCI concrete blocks; no outcome-based selection
independence: Exploratory reuse, not untouched external validation; concrete blocks are one source, not five domains
schema_restriction: Keep every existing numerical field, public bound and equality; omit categorical channels, preserve public IDs and calibration target; renormalize the existing numerical priors within this declared numerical-only schema

paths.A: Totals only: epsilon 5; raw totals and feasible totals using the same bounded affine projection as reconstruction; no row-level utility metrics
paths.B: Rows only: epsilon 5, uniform; clipped noisy row view and existing default physical repair shown separately
paths.C: Both views without reconstruction: epsilon 2.5 for uniform rows + 2.5 for totals; row and total objects evaluated separately
paths.D: Reconstruction of exactly the views from C; no extra query, raw rows or privacy charge

pairing: C and D share exactly the same protected draws; A and C use common research random numbers at different scales. Output states are not independent experiments

aggregate: mean error (relative error equals total relative error for public fixed n)
metrics.zero_denominator: Undefined relative errors/correlations are missing with explicit counts, never set to zero; population standard deviation ddof=0
metrics.reference: Both original and publicly clipped source targets recorded; row shape and public ID order fixed. Original-dependent metrics are offline evaluation only

claims: No single rank across incompatible output objects. Reconstruction cannot improve the feasible target already contained in C's aggregate view. No generic microdata fidelity, production authorization or independent generalization claim
safety: Do not modify src/rupa_privacy. Require fresh full pytest; hash all core files before/after; no confidential inputs and no production ledger bypass
